title: Pi: claude-bridge plugin must stay current for subscription auth — conflicts with exact-version pinning (R6)
description: Claude-in-Pi via subscription confirmed working through the claude-bridge plugin (2026-10-21). The plugin is non-optional for subscription auth and must track upstream auth changes, which pulls against R3's exact Pi pin. Also: Anthropic could block the bridge; acceptable risk while the Claude Code backend stays intact as fallback. See PI-PLAN.md R6.
